prompt: Start of a sweep cycle: FIRST reset the IQ curiosity budget by running 'capture_iq.py --reset-budget' (this re-arms the per-cycle capture allowance). Then run a full-spectrum sweep using sweep.py (start_hz=1000, stop_hz=2000000000). Check the active session for antenna coverage. Update occupancy in the knowledge base. Return a JSON summary of what you found: number of signals, bands with activity, anything new or changed vs the previous sweep. Keep the prompt short.

description: Heartbeat: compare state vs catalog baseline every 30 minutes
prompt: Heartbeat check. Query the catalog for signals seen in the last 30 minutes. Compare against the baseline (signals seen regularly over the last 7 days). Report ONLY signals that are: (1) genuinely new (not in catalog), (2) a known signal that has disappeared, (3) a signal appearing at an unusual time, (4) a signal with changed characteristics. If nothing is anomalous, say nothing — do not send a Telegram message. If anomalies are found, ping the operator with a concise report.

description: Daily RF landscape digest at 20:00 local
prompt: Compose the daily RF digest and send it to the operator via Telegram. Include: (1) occupancy summary by major band (HF/VHF/UHF/SHF), (2) number of identified vs unknown emitters active today, (3) new signals first seen today, (4) signals that disappeared today, (5) any anomalies. Format as a readable Telegram message, Hebrew or English. Draw only from catalog_query — do not fabricate. Timestamp: today.

Generate the weekly spectrum-intelligence article. Call write_article with topic='weekly_summary' and time_window='7d'. Then call council_review on the draft. Save the final draft to the articles directory. Send the operator a Telegram message with the article title, a 3-sentence summary, and the file path — and ask for approval before publishing anywhere. Do NOT publish automatically.

description: Daily cleanup of expired artifacts (retain_until past) — keeps disk lean
prompt: Run artifact cleanup to free disk space: execute 'python3 skills-scripts/artifact_cleanup.py'. Report how many files were deleted and how many MB were freed. If freed_mb > 100, ping the operator with a note.
